items.title: 10.17.3 Oxidising and reducing agents using E standard values (E° values se oxidising aur reducing agents pehchanna) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 10.17.3, printed pages 233-234.

blocks.text: Figure 10.9 (E° values ki list) ko dobara dekhein. Jaise jaise reduction reactions ki E° values zyada negative hoti jati hain:
Equation ke left side ki species kamzor oxidizing agents banti jati hain; woh electrons kam aasani se leti hain.
Equation ke right side ki species strong (taqatwar) reducing agents banti jati hain; woh electrons zyada aasani se deti hain.

Cu, Zn²⁺ ions ko Zn mein reduce nahi karega. To Zn²⁺ ko kaise reduce karein? Jawab: Zn²⁺ ko kisi zyada strong reducing agent se react karayein jis ki E° value Zn²⁺/Zn se zyada negative ho. List mein Mg²⁺/Mg ki E° value zyada negative hai, is liye Mg suitable (theek) reducing agent hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab yahan “Figure 10.11” aur “Figure 10.13” ka hawala deti hai; E° values ki yeh list asal mein Figure 10.9 hai (Figure 10.11 Nernst ka graph hai aur Figure 10.13 kitab mein hai hi nahi).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne zinc ki half-equation Zn²⁺ + e⁻ → Zn chhapi hai. Zn²⁺ ko Zn banne ke liye do electrons chahiye, is liye sahi Zn²⁺ + 2e⁻ → Zn hai.
Zn²⁺ behtar oxidizing agent hai; woh Mg²⁺ ke muqable zyada aasani se electrons leta hai. Mg behtar reducing agent hai; woh Zn ke muqable zyada aasani se electrons deta hai.

Compounds bhi oxidizing aur reducing agents ka kaam karte hain. Misal: KMnO₄ (+1.51 V; kitab mein +0.54 V) aur K₂Cr₂O₇ (+1.33 V) apni zyada E° values ki wajah se oxidizing agents hain, jabke KI aur FeSO₄ apni kam E° values ki wajah se reducing agents hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab KMnO₄ ki value +0.54 V likhti hai; yeh asal mein I₂/2I⁻ ki E° value hai. Acidified KMnO₄ (MnO₄⁻/Mn²⁺) ki E° value +1.51 V hai, isi liye KMnO₄ strong oxidizing agent hai.
Kuch compounds, jaise H₂O₂, oxidizing aur reducing dono agents ka kaam kar sakte hain.

blocks.caption: E° list ko parhna
rows: strong oxidizing agents (Cl₂ +1.36 V, Ag⁺ +0.80 V)
kamzor oxidizing agents (Zn²⁺ −0.76 V, Mg²⁺ −2.38 V)

blocks.prompt: Kya iron (Fe²⁺/Fe, −0.44 V) Zn²⁺ ions ko reduce kar sakta hai?
blocks.explanation: Nahi. Reduce karne ke liye reducing agent ki E° value Zn²⁺/Zn (−0.76 V) se zyada negative honi chahiye. Iron ki −0.44 V kam negative hai, is liye Fe + Zn²⁺ ka E°cell = (−0.76) − (−0.44) = −0.32 V negative hai.

items: E° zyada negative: left species kamzor oxidizing agent, right species strong reducing agent.
Mg (−2.38 V) Zn²⁺ (−0.76 V) ko reduce kar sakta hai; Cu nahi kar sakta.
KMnO₄, K₂Cr₂O₇ oxidizing agents; KI, FeSO₄ reducing agents; H₂O₂ dono.
